findings.what: insertContactMessage is not wrapped in error handling; a DB failure throws from the server action, showing a generic error page instead of an inline form error and possibly losing the visitor's input.

Client maxLength counts UTF-16 code units while server validation (src/lib/contact.ts:28-30) counts code points, so astral-plane input (emoji) is truncated client-side before reaching the server's 100/2000 limit.
SQLite file defaults to process.cwd()/data; persistence depends on a writable, non-ephemeral filesystem, which is not documented as a deployment constraint.
Public form has no rate limiting or spam protection; anyone can flood contact_messages.
